problem_restatement.input: V58 has no frequent BTC-long route. Sweep relaxation, trend-pullback reacceleration, raw Hulk side inversion, Range Onset, HT-Breakout transfer, EMA-speed continuation, structural continuation, order-flow impulse, breadth expansion, and OI-deleveraging variants have negative or contradictory evidence.
problem_restatement.output: Test one materially different BTC-only long mechanism that requires a completed hourly price breakout while the latest causally available settled Hyperliquid funding rate is negative.
problem_restatement.stakeholder: Operator seeking meaningful but evidence-bound growth from a live-capital portfolio.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Determine whether negative settled funding identifies a stable after-cost subset of BTC hourly breakouts and adds evidence not explained by an otherwise identical unconditioned breakout.

hypothesis: A completed BTC hourly breakout above the previous twenty completed hourly highs may have better long continuation quality when the latest already-settled Hyperliquid funding rate is negative, because the perpetual contract is then below its funding benchmark or short demand is dominant rather than long demand being visibly crowded.
claim_boundaries: Negative funding is a venue-specific positioning and price-gap proxy, not proof that spot led the move.
The cited perpetual-futures literature explains funding mechanics and sentiment interpretation; it does not establish this strategy's directional edge.
No candidate return, trade, win rate, profit factor, or path outcome was inspected before this contract was written.
The historical partitions have been opened by other project studies, so multiple-testing and researcher-familiarity risk remain material.

mechanism_novelty.claim: No prior project artifact found before preregistration tests this exact conjunction of BTC-only completed-hourly twenty-bar breakout onset, EMA21/55 uptrend, latest strictly prior negative settled Hyperliquid funding, and the frozen 60/60/24h economics.
closest_rejected_families: generic immediate breakout and HT-Breakout cross-asset transfer
mechanism_novelty.material_difference: The primary event is a BTC hourly structural breakout conditioned on a causally prior venue-native funding state; it does not invert Hulk, transfer HYPE rules, require a downside sweep, use a pullback state, use OI, or use L2 flow.
mechanism_novelty.falsifier: An exact preexisting project implementation or result with the same event and economic identity invalidates novelty and must stop result generation until reconciled.

external_primary_references.title: Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures
external_primary_references.authors: Songrun He, Asaf Manela, Omri Ross, Victor von Wachter
external_primary_references.supported_role: Funding is designed to reflect and narrow perpetual-versus-spot price gaps; negative funding means shorts pay longs under the studied convention.
external_primary_references.unsupported_inference: The paper does not validate negative-funding hourly breakouts as a profitable long strategy.

external_primary_references.title: Reconciling Open Interest with Traded Volume in Perpetual Swaps
external_primary_references.supported_role: Funding mechanics are venue-specific and incentivize positions that narrow the perpetual-index dislocation.
external_primary_references.unsupported_inference: The paper does not establish return prediction from the Hyperliquid funding sign.

explicitly_not_inspected: future BTC returns conditional on funding
breakout event outcomes conditional on funding
outcome_blind_feature_feasibility.threshold_provenance: economic sign convention rather than a return-selected quantile

frozen_mechanism_control.definition: identical completed-hourly EMA21/55 uptrend, twenty-prior-high breakout, onset, entry, exit, sizing, funding cashflow, and friction contract with only the negative-funding entry predicate removed
frozen_mechanism_control.purpose: falsify the claim that the negative-funding condition adds value rather than merely selecting ordinary BTC breakouts

parameter_provenance.twenty_hour_high: same fixed prior-twenty-hour structural horizon used by the current BTC sweep route, mirrored to the upside
parameter_provenance.negative_funding: unambiguous economic sign boundary selected without return inspection
parameter_provenance.economic_exit: unchanged V58 BTC sweep-control 60bps stop, 60bps target, and 24h fallback to isolate entry quality

partition_disclosure: All three partitions were opened by prior project research. This mechanism and its exact parameters were frozen before its own candidate returns, but the evidence is retrospective and exposed to project-level multiple testing.

acceptance_and_disposition_contract.trial_abort_policy: Only a technical integrity failure aborts result publication. Sparse, losing, high-drawdown, or zero-trade outcomes remain reportable results.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.cadence_requirement_basis: Thirteen trades per ninety-day partition approximates one completed opportunity per week and is a declared usefulness criterion rather than a trial-abort gate.
acceptance_and_disposition_contract.if_any_support_requirement_fails: reject this exact candidate without threshold tuning or live proposal
live_proposal_requires_additionally: shared one-BTC-position comparison against the unchanged V58 sweep and both V58 short routes
prospective post-preregistration signal and exact BBO capture
verified flat and order-free transition boundary

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: Negative funding may identify bearish information rather than an uncrowded bullish setup.
The conjunction may be too sparse for practical use despite the funding feature's marginal frequency.
A funding observation can be stale relative to the breakout even though it is causally available.
Hyperliquid funding alone cannot distinguish spot-led demand from cross-venue futures demand.
The opened historical partitions create selection and multiple-testing risk.
One-minute OHLC cannot establish exact intraminute mark ordering, queue position, or depth.
The fixed 60/60 exit isolates entry quality but may not be optimal for a trend continuation mechanism.
A positive standalone result may still displace stronger V58 BTC routes in shared capital.
falsifiers: Implementation differs from the exact completed-hour breakout, strictly prior funding, onset, gap, entry, exit, sizing, fee, funding-cashflow, delay, or slippage contract.
Independent reconstruction changes any signal identity, trade lifecycle, or aggregate metric.
Any candidate support requirement fails in validation or pseudo-holdout.
The unconditioned control matches or outperforms the primary, falsifying incremental value from the funding predicate.
Prospective source-compatible signals cannot execute at modeled size and friction or disagree with completed source bars.
